import sys

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    parents = list(map(int, input[1:]))

    depth = [0] * (n + 1)
    result = []

    for i in range(1, n):
        parent = parents[i - 1]
        depth[i + 1] = depth[parent] + 1
        result.append(depth[i + 1])

    print(" ".join(map(str, result)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
